experiment_data.hypothesis: TCN (Temporal Conditioning Noise, σ=0.2) on dt_embedding during imagination rollout will suppress CIVO in ManiSkill PickCube-v1, as it did in Walker Walk, by preventing the world model from overfitting to fixed dt signals.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/event-gated-adaptive-horizon && LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so.6 MUJOCO_GL=egl MUJOCO_EGL_DEVICE_ID=0 python -u dreamer.py --configs defaults maniskill --task maniskill_PickCube-v1 --gate_enabled True --gate_fixed_dt 2 --gate_subsample_max_dt 2 --imag_horizon 8 --tcn_sigma 0.2 --seed 0 --steps 200000 --compile False --device cuda:0 --logdir ./logdir/exp_031_tcn_pickcube_s0_sigma02"
